entities.name: Orgg
entities.description: A Dominarian race of powerful, dumb hybrids between Orcs and Ogres, with green skin, batlike ears, massive teeth and two pairs of arms.

entities.name: Orcs
entities.description: One of the two races that Orggs are hybrids of.

entities.name: Ogres
entities.description: One of the two races that Orggs are hybrids of.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Orggs are known to have existed.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: A continent of Dominaria where Orggs were used in the war against Icatia.

entities.name: Icatian Empire
entities.description: The empire fought by the goblin-orc alliance on Sarpadia.

entities.name: Ironclaw Orcs
entities.description: A group of cowardly but cunning orcs who fought the Order of Leitbur and created the Orgg.

entities.name: Order of Leitbur
entities.description: The enemies of the Ironclaw Orcs.

entities.name: Reod Dai
entities.description: A figure who killed one of the Ironclaw Orcs.

entities.name: Gatha
entities.description: Appears from the card Twisted Experiment to have created an Orgg around 3863 AR during the War with Phyrexia.

entities.name: War with Phyrexia
entities.description: The war during which an Orgg appears to have been created by Gatha.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: Where Orggs were known to exist around 4050 AR.

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: A faction possibly responsible for Orggs on Otaria, to fight in their pits.

events.summary: Orggs are used in the war against Icatia by the goblin-orc alliance on Sarpadia around AR 170.
events.quote: On Sarpadia , Orggs were used in the war against Icatia by the goblin -orc alliance around AR 170.

events.summary: Reod Dai kills one of the Ironclaw Orcs.
events.quote: Reod Dai killed one of them.

events.summary: Gatha appears to create an Orgg around 3863 AR during the War with Phyrexia.
events.quote: appears to show the creation of an Orgg by Gatha around 3863 AR

events.summary: Orggs are known to exist on Otaria around 4050 AR, possibly created by the Cabal.
events.quote: It is possible that they were created by the Cabal to fight in their pits.

relations.note: The Ironclaw Orcs created the Orgg.
relations.quote: They also had created the Orgg.

relations.note: The orcs were cowardly when fighting their enemies, the Order of Leitbur.
relations.quote: when it came to fighting their enemies, the Order of Leitbur

relations.note: Twisted Experiment appears to show Gatha creating an Orgg.
relations.quote: appears to show the creation of an Orgg by Gatha around 3863 AR

relations.note: Possibly created Orggs on Otaria to fight in their pits.
relations.quote: It is possible that they were created by the Cabal to fight in their pits.
